title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Braden Smith (foot) activated from IR
items.desc: Braden Smith (foot) will be active for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Smith has yet to play this season. He was reportedly close to being activated for last Sunday's game , but the Texans waited one more week. After eight seasons with the Colts, Smith will make his debut for the Texans on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Quessenberry to start at left tackle for Rams
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said David Quessenberry will start at left tackle for the Rams.
items.impact: Quessenberry will get the opportunity with Alaric Jackson suspended.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keagen Trost (hamstring) to return to practice this week
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Keagen Trost will return to practice this week.
items.impact: Trost suffered a hamstring injury during the preseason. He'll have 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) will not return to practice this week

items.impact: Garrett remains week-to-week to return from injured reserve.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) has a chance to play in Week 6
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (ankle) has a chance to play against the Browns in Week 6.
items.impact: Jackson has a "realistic chance" to play in Week 6, according to a league source. The Ravens' dual-threat QB did not play in Sunday's win over the Falcons after spraining his ankle the week prior. Jackson's practice status should be monitored this week. Tyler Huntley would start again if Jackson cannot go.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Anton Harrison (knee) lands on IR
items.desc: Anton Harrison (knee) has been placed on IR.
items.impact: Harrison is set to undergo knee surgery after the Jaguars return from the UK. This is certainly a blow to the Jaguars' offense, as Harrison has been a mainstay on the offensive line since being selected in the first round of the 2023 draft. Walker Little will step in at left tackle.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Walker Little to start at left tackle in Week 6
items.desc: Walker Little will start at left tackle against the Texans on Sunday.
items.impact: With Anton Harrison (knee) landing on IR, the Jaguars will turn to Little at left tackle. Little has played solely as a backup and on special teams this season, but he has 39 career NFL starts.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) expected to practice this week
items.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) is expected to practice this week and has a shot to play this weekend.
items.impact: It's a small sample size, but the Ravens seemed poised to give Lane a sizeable workload before he suffered the injury. He will likely be on some semblance of a snap count to start off, but should be back to full strength soon. He's an intriguing waiver pickup if available.
